buildHistory.description: Chickens wandering loosely around the town in the 3D world — peck, wander, scuttle aside; wild animals still keep out.
Clean 3D play screen — banner and diagnostic/help words into Options, compact status strip, Hide UI toggle.
Sprint button hold + tap-to-toggle, robust multi-touch hold, no-op slide pin fix.
Minecraft-style blocky characters — big square heads, goofy faces, hats on nearly everyone.
Sprint shakiness fix — perpendicular wall-slide + exhaustion rearm gate.
Tired-state shakiness fix — tap-to-move slide stall + press-while-tired rearm hole. (Re-trigger commit 00a3f115: deploy job failed, same content.)
Path cobbles/slabs render whole-world — no more pop at the detail-window edge.
Zoom out twice as far in 3D mode — orbit max 32 to 64 (first-person pitch flip rode along in BUILD 1022's commit).
Grass and little details render farther + infinite world past the old edge. (Re-trigger commit e49d3521: deploy job stuck, same content.)
Rocks placeable + removable in Build mode.
Sprint actually works — wider tap window, persistent latch, Release! label, half the rebuild stutter.
Water — a basic ocean west of town, placeable in Build mode.
Walls removable + in the Build menu; Sprint is a small icon next to Gold.
Saved chunks keep the inn, blacksmith, and general store.
Tap-to-walk pathfinding (player A* + NPC pathing fixes). Landed: commit 9dc4cdf7, deploy run 42428294182 success, phone probe PASS 0 page errors.

Distant wild lakes render as their real shape: far cells now scan the whole cell so a lake subdivides into its actual tiles instead of painting the whole cell blue; the lake stays put as the player walks. Landed: commit 336741da, deploy run 42431099076 success, phone probe PASS 0 page errors.

House interiors keep you inside: the walls are solid now — you can only leave through the Exit button (or the E key), which puts you back on the doorstep, and you can walk straight back in again. Landed: commit 7d1c8cf9, deploy run 42432401556 success, phone probe PASS 0 page errors.

Red sports car: tap the Car button and it appears next to you, Enter Car (or E) to get in, drives at 10x walking speed, Exit Car (or E) to step out — the car stays parked. Session-only (not saved). Landed: commit 7a9671d4, deploy run 42434904636 success, phone probe PASS 0 page errors.

Ashfall Stage 2 terrain: rolling hills (visual-only heightfield), stronger ground tint, shores (sand band + foam edge), stone revived on high ground. Heightfield SHIPPED (not the fallback). Walkability unchanged. Landed: commit 62354ebf, deploy run 42438231684 success, phone probe PASS 0 page errors.

Car lag fix: the world rebuild is now time-sliced across frames while moving (10ms/frame) and ~50% cheaper, so driving is smooth with no stutter at chunk boundaries. The world renders exactly as before (identical vertex counts). Landed: commit 452da72b, deploy run 42441522022 success, phone probe PASS 0 page errors.

Town Builder Stage 1: persistent cursor placement + rotation — pick an asset and it stays attached to the cursor with a green/red preview, stays selected after placing so another copy goes down immediately; R / Shift+R or the panel buttons rotate houses 90° so their doors face the path. Landed: commit 0b21aba4, deploy run 42446451401 success, phone probe PASS 0 page errors.

Town Builder Stage 2 AREA SELECT: drag a yellow rectangle to select a whole area (houses, trees, roads, rocks, walls, decorations, whole town sections); then Move/Rotate/Delete/Duplicate the group together, preserving spacing and rotations, each action one Undo step. Landed: commit 67880190, deploy run 42455687148 success, phone probe PASS 0 page errors.

Windmill (pulled forward from Town Builder Stage 4): a placeable windmill in the Build menu (Buildings) — a 3x3 stone tower with a pyramid cap and four big sails on the front that turn slowly in the wind; enterable through its door; rotates with R / the panel buttons so the sails face the way you want. Landed: commit 8963bc65, deploy run 42463440575 success, phone probe PASS 0 page errors.

Town Builder Stage 3 unlimited undo/redo: CTRL+Z undoes and CTRL+Y (or CTRL+Shift+Z) redoes, and the Undo/Redo buttons do the same — for every Build-mode change (placing, deleting, moving, rotating, pasting a chunk, whole AREA SELECT moves/rotations/deletions/duplications, each as one step), with no limit on how far back you can go. Landed: commit fa257044, deploy run 42470997314 success, phone probe PASS 0 page errors.

Town Builder Stage 4 asset library: the Build menu is now organized into categories (Buildings / Houses / Shops / Decorations / Roads / Nature / Infrastructure). New: Lanterns (glow at night), Bushes (walk-through), the Mine (enterable), Ore Deposits, and the Wooden Bridge (place it over the ocean or the pond and walk straight across the water). Landed: commit 58aa5ecd, deploy run 42480115688 success, phone probe PASS 0 page errors.

Farm land for the windmill: placeable tilled soil (Nature) that grows green shoots after 1 in-game hour and tall golden wheat after 3 in-game hours; stand next to ready wheat and press E to harvest 2 wheat (Wheat counter next to Wood/Stone/Gold); farmer villagers walk to ready wheat and harvest it too; after harvest it regrows on its own, so you never re-plant. Landed: commit 58529b47, deploy run 42520672033 success, phone probe PASS 0 page errors.

Town Builder Stage 5 layout helpers: 9 optional tools in the AREA SELECT menu — Doors face paths, Trees off paths, Lanterns along roads, Fence property (new fence kind), Align row/column, ENHANCE, Spread out/Pack together. Nothing moves unless the player taps a tool; one Undo undoes the whole helper. Scale/elevation/tree rotation/vegetation size are not here — no per-item size feature exists yet, stated plainly. The Town Builder is now complete (Stages 1-5, builds 1036-1042). Landed: commit 8041e127, deploy run 42532242988 success, phone probe PASS 0 page errors.

Import Hub Stage 1: a hub panel at the top of the Build panel that imports .glb (as before), .gltf (pick its .bin at the same time if it has one), .obj, or a ZIP holding any of those — several files at once, or a whole folder on a desktop browser where the browser supports it. Imported models show in the hub and the Custom category, place like any other item, and one Undo removes them. Honest limits: models render as plain coloured triangles (textures ignored); on iPhone Safari a folder cannot be opened directly; audio is not imported yet (no audio playback in the game); ChatGPT cannot reach files on the phone or computer — uploading here is how a model gets into the game. Landed: commit 4a82b393, deploy run 42542648558 success, phone probe PASS 0 page errors.

Import Hub Stage 2 — IndexedDB asset store: imported models now live in a proper on-device store (IndexedDB database ashfall-custom-assets v1, compact versioned manifest in localStorage, metadata only). Per-file cap 1 MB -> 5 MB; library up to 50 MB decoded / 100,000 triangles. Existing uploads migrate automatically once (read-back validated before the legacy key is deleted; a failed move keeps the old copy and the hub says so). Library loads from IndexedDB before placement/rendering with a loading state; the world still boots if IndexedDB is unavailable. Upload failures (including running out of device storage) show a clear message naming the file and the reason. Landed: commit a93a1d69, deploy run 42555446176 success, phone probe PASS 0 page errors.

Import Hub Stage 3 — preview + library: the hub now shows each model before it joins the library — a real preview drawn from the model's own geometry (software rasterizer, isometric, painter's depth sort, flat mean-vertex-colour fill), with footprint, height, triangles, source file, and format, plus editable name/category/tags. Nothing joins the library until the player taps Add to Asset Library; Cancel drops it (nothing was ever written). Library rows show a 44px preview + name/category/tags/dimensions/source/format, with Rename, per-row category select and tags input, Place, Delete. Search matches name/tag/source filename; filter by category/format; sort by name/format/category/triangles. Import progress is real files/bytes read (staged import, yields to the event loop between files). A model with no triangles says 'cannot preview' instead of showing a fake picture. Landed: commit 81d17b79, deploy run 42566273686 success, phone probe PASS 0 page errors.

Import Hub Stage 4 — packs / recovery: ZIP import is checked before anything imports — traversal paths (../, absolute, drive-letter, .. mid-path, NUL byte), ZIP-bomb expansion (>100x compressed size, checked on declared central-directory sizes before inflating), >50 MB total uncompressed expansion, >50 entries, ZIP >5 MB, single entry >5 MB, duplicate entry names, and bad CRCs are rejected or skipped with a reason, and a bad entry never aborts the whole import. A .gltf resolves its .bin and named textures relative to its own directory inside the ZIP (subfolders, ../ that stays inside the container); a URI that escapes the container, an absolute path, or a URL is never followed — a missing .bin still fails naming the file, a missing texture is reported, never silently dropped, never claimed as applied (textures are still never rendered). After an import the hub reports exactly which models landed, which entries were skipped and why, and which failed. 'Export library as a ZIP' downloads ashfall-asset-pack.zip — every model in its original format plus ashfall-asset-pack.json (name, format, category, tags, dimensions, triangles, source file); re-importing a pack restores names, categories, and tags from the manifest. If an import would use a name that already exists, the hub asks first — Keep both (renames the newcomer), Replace (removes the old model and its placed copies with one undo stroke, then adds the new one under the same name), or Skip — instead of overwriting silently. Landed: commit 5bea9115, deploy run 42579328390 success, phone probe PASS 0 page errors.

Import Hub Stage 5 — AI / development handoff: tick models in the library (or a whole category, or the whole library) and export a ZIP with the models in their original formats, the pack manifest (stamped with the build number), and a short handoff-summary.txt you can copy and paste into your chat. On a device that supports sharing files from the browser, a Share button sends the ZIP straight to the share sheet; otherwise it downloads to this device (on iPhone, find it in Files) and you upload it in your chat. Honest limits, in plain words: ChatGPT and Muse cannot see the files in your browser on their own — nothing reaches them until you upload the ZIP yourself — and the game itself does not run an AI; the files are for an AI to read, name, categorise, or rework into a new pack. Landed: commit a5cfa961, deploy run 42591830479 success, phone probe PASS 0 page errors.

Import Hub Stage 6 — integration: imported models are now full citizens of Build mode. Rotation did not exist for customs at all — the renderer ignored rot, R / rotate buttons were gated to palette kinds, and movePlacement dropped rot on a moved custom. Now: rotateCustomXZ + customFootprint, the renderer rotates the mesh's local XZ, the ghost preview validates/draws at the armed rotation with a 'rotated 90 deg' label, R and the rotate buttons work for an armed custom, and Move keeps rot. Chunk capture/paste excluded customs — now chunks capture customs with assetId + rot; paste validates against the live library, and a missing model skips with the reason 'that model is no longer in your library' — never a silent drop. AREA SELECT skipped customs on duplicate and rotate — duplicateArea now routes customs through pasteChunk; planRotate advances a custom's rot. Already true and now proven (not rebuilt): arm/place with ghost preview, Move, Undo/Redo, Remove, save/reload, the 1039 delete rule. Scale — NOT built, said plainly: a render-only scale would lie about the collision rect; a true scale must change footprint, validation, ghost, move/rotate math, area-select, and chunk capture — not small and safe in the last stage. The Import Hub is now complete (Stages 1-6, builds 1043-1048). Landed: commit 6430a5c3, deploy run 42610828517 success, phone probe PASS 0 page errors.
